why: User directive: the core properties (QED / SA / ADMET) must be benchmarked on an existing checkpoint BEFORE any loss or architecture work, so the work is driven by what is missing rather than guessed. Training was stopped at epoch 27 of 50 for this.
generated_cohort: molmetal/reports/cfm_fullcorpus_2026_10_10/generated_smiles.csv, last epoch, 66 molecules, produced by integrating the ODE from noise
reference_cohort: 636 real tmQM val complexes, bond-head decoded (the training distribution itself)

THE_CENTRAL_FINDING.statement: The REAL tmQM reference misses every target too. QED 0.2685 (target 0.50), SA 5.0269 (target 3.0), logS -8.34 (target -4.0).
THE_CENTRAL_FINDING.what_it_means: tmQM is a set of DFT-optimised structures, not a drug-like molecule library. It cannot serve as the yardstick for 'does this reach the literature average' -- it can only answer 'is the generator close to its own training distribution'.
THE_CENTRAL_FINDING.therefore: The gap measured here is RELATIVE (generated vs training distribution), not ABSOLUTE (vs published SOTA). The absolute comparison needs a literature baseline that is being researched separately; do not quote these as a competitiveness verdict.

generated_vs_reference.qed: 0.0944 vs 0.2685 -- the generator is at 35% of its own training distribution
generated_vs_reference.sa: 6.4423 vs 5.0269 -- 1.42 WORSE (higher SA = harder to synthesise)
generated_vs_reference.logs: -8.0099 vs -8.3385 -- the generator is marginally BETTER

what_this_does_NOT_cover: VINA / docking. Not runnable on this task as posed: CFM generates metal complexes with no protein pocket. Whether published metallodrug generators report docking at all is an open question being researched.
n=66 on one seed. Not a settled number.
The ADMET trio are RDKit/Crippen/Veber/Delaney HEURISTICS, not assay measurements.

sa.source: Ertl 2009; SA <= 3 is the common synthesability threshold

ames_mutagen.source: Wf-297D band; Benegini-Bossa 2012 / Kazius 2005 via RDKit FilterCatalog

tool: scripts/cfm_checkpoint_benchmark.py (new). Measures only; it writes to the caller-specified --out-json and touches nothing in metrics/by_metric/.
bug_found_while_writing_it: the first version imported calculateScore from molmetal.molmetal_lam.reward.sa_score, which does not export it, and swallowed the ImportError -- leaving SA as NA for every cohort. Fixed to use the same RDKit-Contrib late import the panel uses (cfm_property_panel.py:117). A silent all-NA column is the same failure shape as today's other four.
